product_summary: Group site avocarbon.com (AVO Carbon, French-headquartered carbon/electro-mechanical components group) lists the real product lines: (1) Carbon Brushes for electric motors — automotive (starters/alternators, e-drivetrains, auxiliary motors), power tools, white goods, industrial motors; (2) Carbon & Electrical Assemblies (brush card assemblies — described as 'part of the heart of the electric motor'); (3) Mechanical Seals (dynamic sealing for pumps/agitators); (4) Chokes / inductors — passive electronic components; (5) Bushings, rotors & vanes — friction materials. Source: https://www.avocarbon.com/products/brushes/ and https://www.avocarbon.com/en/contact/ (site navigation: Products = Carbon Brushes, Carbon & Electrical Assemblies, Mechanical Seals, Inductors, Bushings/Rotors/Vanes). No India-specific page or catalogue was retrievable — the group 'Locations' page returned 404 on the paths tried, so the Indian entity's own product scope is not publicly confirmed.
role_hint: manufacturer (group-level: design, material preparation and manufacturing of carbon brushes and assemblies; no trader signs found). India entity's own manufacturing vs. distribution role not verifiable from public pages.
comment: HS 854520 ('Carbon brushes') is the correct heading for the core product and is corroborated by the group's own product page — partial match, not exact, because the declared single code covers only one of five declared product families. Missing from the declaration: 854590 (other carbon/graphite articles for electrical use — friction materials, vanes, bushings), 850300 (parts of electric motors/generators — brush card assemblies), 848420 (mechanical seals), 850450 (inductors/chokes), 848330 (bearing housings/bushings, if the bushings are metallic). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: the real profile is electromechanical components / carbon-graphite for motors, automotive and appliance supply — electronics is only a minor adjacent line (chokes). No customs line was available to this researcher, so the actual shipped HS mix is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'; the product list itself is confirmed only at group level, not for the Indian legal entity. Per project rule 3, no rejection on HS grounds — company retained, code set to 854520 as primary with the additional codes above.
